title: Predictive Admit-Score SLI and Golden-Signal Canvas for Preemptive Region Failover
creator: Evan Chen
description: Objective: Implement an end-to-end telemetry + visualization pipeline for a predictive Admit-Score SLI that forecasts admission pressure at token granularity and surfaces an operator-facing dashboard to drive automated region failover and probabilistic circuit breaking. This ticket covers instrumentation, model inference hooks, dashboard panels, and an oncall playbook for operator responses.
acceptance_criteria: Admit-Score SLI computed in production telemetry stream: rolling 1m, 5m, 15m windows + forecast horizon (30s, 60s)
Dashboard with panels: admit-score heatmap by region/shard, token-latency attribution waterfall, forecast confidence bands, circuit probability indicator
Synthetic probe harness that exercises prefix-heavy workloads and validates admit-score predictions against observed admits/fails in canary region
Operator runbook attached to dashboard with automated escalation and failover steps (manual and automatic modes)
progress_updates: 2026-02-11: Spike done — implemented streaming aggregator prototype using existing golden-signal pipeline (kinesis -> metrics-processor). Verified token-level timers pass through without schema change.
2026-02-18: Chose forecasting approach: lightweight AR(2) with exponential smoothing on admit-rate and median token latency. Rationale: low compute, explainability for oncall vs heavier LSTM.
2026-02-25: Telemetry enrichment PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/881) to add 'admit_score' and 'admit_reason' tags to token traces. Awaiting review from Observability team.
2026-03-01: Dashboard mockups reviewed with PM and SRE — added density contours for prefix-length cohorts to quickly spot prefix-driven degradation.
2026-03-05: Canary synthetic harness scheduled for 2026-03-09 in us-west-2-canary. Synthetic load tuned to 0.5% of production QPS initially (configurable).
technical_notes: Admit-Score definition: normalized value in [0,1] combining current admit rate (tokens admitted / tokens requested), queue depth percentile, and p99 decode latency. Weighting: admit_rate 0.5, queue_depth 0.3, tail_latency 0.2 (initial). We expose components separately for debugging.
Sampling: Full token tracing is too expensive. Use reservoir sampling of 1 in 200 token requests by default, adaptive up to 1 in 20 under elevated admit_score > 0.6 to improve attribution fidelity.
Storage/retention: metrics stored in metrics-store with 90d retention (aggregates) and 7d raw sampled traces. Consider 180d for correlation investigations — follow-on PR required.
Metric names: rwi_admit_score{region,shard,model,tier}, rwi_token_p99_ms{region,shard,model}, rwi_queue_depth_p95{region,shard}, rwi_admit_rate{region,shard}
Forecasting: compute short-horizon forecast (30s,60s) using incremental AR with online parameter update. We record model residuals to detect concept drift and fall back to simple threshold rules.
Privacy: remove prompt text from telemetry. Keep hashed prefix fingerprint for cohorting. Confirmed with Privacy and Legal that hashed fingerprints with salt are acceptable (Confluence link below).
decisions: Use explainable AR forecasting vs ML blackbox for initial rollout (decision made 2026-02-18).
Expose admit_score as SLI (not SLA) and keep automatic region failover gated behind opt-in feature flag per-customer. Rationale: reduce blast radius and allow staged rollouts.
Dashboard will be the authoritative operator surface and must include a one-click 'record-snapshot' export for postmortem analysis.
testing_plan: Unit tests for metric derivation and forecast computation with syntheticSequences from fixtures
Integration tests: end-to-end telemetry ingestion in staging with synthetic prefix-heavy traces
Canary: deploy telemetry + dashboard to us-west-2-canary and run synthetic harness on 2026-03-09; validate predicted admits vs observed within 10% for 30s horizon
Chaos: schedule token-loss and increased queuing latency experiments in canary to validate circuit heuristics and rollback behavior
runbook: If admit_score(region) > 0.75 for 3 consecutive 30s intervals: notify oncall (SRE) and open incident with label 'admit-pressure'
Verify synthetic probe diffs and token-attr waterfall to determine prefix cohorts driving pressure
If forecast_confidence high and cross-region capacity available: promote automatic region-failover (if customer opted in) or escalate to manual failover steps in console
Fallback: if dashboard telemetry lost, trigger degrade-to-default rule (fallback-model: small-gpt-1) and throttle heavy prefix cohorts via per-tenant rate limits
